author: Mark Atwood
text:
BLOCKED waiting on cross-repo work in mime-tree.

Strategy chosen (per closed JMAP-g7wu.11): extend mime-tree to expose typed header values for the 5 RFC 8621 As* forms, then jmap-mail-server consumes mime-tree's new API. Do NOT add mail-parser as a direct dep — mime-tree is the workspace's single gateway to RFC 5322 parsing.

Cross-repo bead: MIME-vy5 in ~/PROJECT/MIME (project prefix MIME). That bead must land (+ a mime-tree minor version bump) before this one can proceed.

To unblock: when MIME-vy5 is closed, run 'bd update JMAP-g7wu.5 --status open' and the autonomous loop will pick it back up.
